statute_version_applicable: Cal. Penal Code §632 (post-1967, pre-2016 — §632 unchanged by 2016 amendment)
rule_established: Confidential communication under §632(c) = objective circumstances test; telephone calls made without knowledge of recording are presumptively confidential; content sensitivity does not control
